translation.name: Diosa' kiika; Génesis, Éxodo y El Nuevo Testamento

content: Entsai' dyañu, bene kai'sha Diosyaa tsanguekaantsuve tyainuu jumu kamain ke' keewara tsamantsa keenbashiinuu jumu faañu katawayu: mandishpai anjeela de-insha mandishpai bijee taaju puiwaanutsumu tadeenu katawayu. Juntsa mandishpai bijee taaju i' puiwaanutsumuchi deke' dyataa, ya' ajara dyawaanu juwa.

Tsenmin lamaaren tsamantsa ishdangatataa ju' ñilluba yandaa katawayu. Tsenñu juntsa lamaa pi kelunu, naa firuu animaanu bain, naa ya keraa jumu chi nawawanu bain aawa kure' keewaatyula, naa ne ya' mumu numeru juu bain vityula de-uinawa, Dios kuñu arpa taandene.
Tsejtu Diosa' chachi, Moisés' beesa bain, naa Llupu Kaa Uveja' beesa bain ke' entsandii detiwa:

content.text: Tsenmin naake ura' kemu ju'ba juntsaave
¿Maa ñunu tsamantsa ura rukuve ti'chu deenga?
ñu yumaa ke' keewaañu' mitya, tiidetiwa.

content: Bene mangue-eewayu, tsenñu kai'sha chumu Diosa' pupunanu yasha Dioschin juu jumu suku jurudiwa, Diosa' tsandipañu keewara babuu pumu.

Tsenñu Diosa' pupunanu yanu mandishpai anjee main main ma taaju puiwara tanamula, tiba mayijtu naraa linu jali, pi'kelaa tene panaa, tsenmin yala' ajpele kai'tala uru ajpeendee chuwachi tene telaa defaawa.
Tsenmala main juntsa taapai bibu chumula, naa-uwanuba chumu Dioschi, chachillanu ajaatya' keewara uru shullanu tyuwaañuu jumu, main main juntsa mandishpai anjeelanu kuwa.

Tsenñu, Diosa' pupunanu yanu ñivijcha tene yalluiwa, tsamantsaa jumu Dios tsanguikaañu' mitya. Tsenñu Diosa' pupunanu yapayanu muba vinu dejutyuwa, anjeela juntsa mandishpai taaju puiwara kayu deke' dyaindetyuya.
